macro.event: Initial Jobless Claims, week ending Sept 12 — LANDED
macro.consensus: was ~205K; came in at 196,000, DOWN 10,000 from an unrevised 206,000, and the 4-week average fell to 203,250. Insured unemployment 1,730,000, rate 1.1%. No crack in the labour market — this is the print that lets Warsh keep hiking

macro.event: Philadelphia Fed Manufacturing Survey, September — LANDED
macro.consensus: was UNRECONCILED at 27.5/30.5/31.3/37; came in at 37.8, down from 47.4 but well above every published estimate. The internals matter more than the beat: prices paid +8 to 48.6, prices received +14 to 31.3 (highest since April), employment −16 to 11.8, new orders 29.2

macro.event: Bank of Japan policy decision — LANDED
macro.consensus: was +25bp to 1.25%, and that was DELIVERED — the highest Japanese policy rate since 1995. But the vote was 7-2 with BOTH dissents DOVISH (Asada and Sato, each preferring no change), and the yen fell anyway: USD/JPY +1.2% to ~157.8
macro.note: effective Sept 24; guidance retained — the Bank 'will continue to raise the policy interest rate'
